unhappened_classes.title: /halt and /flatten can confirm to the owner while the flag never reaches origin
unhappened_classes.scenario: scripts/telegram_commands.py _write_flag() writes halt.json FIRST (dirtying the tracked file), then runs 'git pull --rebase' - which refuses a dirty tree (the 2026-09-04 class) - then commits on a stale base and pushes; all four subprocess calls use capture_output=True with return codes ignored. If origin ever moves ahead of the VPS checkout (one dropped push, one snapshot race), the push is rejected non-fast-forward, and every subsequent command fails the same way FOREVER (local stays ahead), while the owner receives 'FLATTEN armed - all paper positions close at the next cycle' each time. The engine, which reads the flag from a fresh clone of origin in v10_lab.yml, keeps trading. The sentinel's 'off-box snapshot repo' row uses git_commit on the LOCAL checkout, so the stuck-unpushed commit reads as fresh - the watcher confirms the lie.
unhappened_classes.precedent: 2026-09-04 (late) dirty tracked file silently kills every pull-first cron; 2026-07-06 FLUSH LIED ABOUT PFE (never record an action that didn't confirm); 2026-06-22 persist silently aborted; 2026-09-07 the watchdog's messenger failed silently.
unhappened_classes.check: In _write_flag: pull BEFORE writing the flag, check every returncode, and after push compare 'git rev-parse HEAD' against 'git ls-remote origin main'; the Telegram confirmation is sent ONLY on match, otherwise the reply is 'COMMAND FAILED TO PUBLISH - engine has NOT received it' (fail-loud, one line). Add a push_sync sentinel row (the kind already exists for '.') pointed at /home/poller/harvest-snapshots.

unhappened_classes.title: The freshness sentinel and its date math are holiday-blind, despite claiming otherwise
unhappened_classes.scenario: freshness_sentinel.py's docstring says 'weekend/holiday-aware' but last_expected() knows only day-of-week sets and trading_days_behind() counts every Mon-Fri. A page that cries wolf 9+ mornings a year is a page the owner learns to skim, which is how the next real 08:00 alarm gets missed. The 2026-09-07 entry already shows Labor Day interacting badly with this exact reporting path.
